texts:
Monday's notes, team by team: what Sunday's injuries look like a day later, and the first Week 8 reports ahead of Thursday night.

Christian McCaffrey

Lamar Jackson

Saquon Barkley
#FTTB #RavensFlock #FlyEaglesFly

Christian McCaffrey has a mild hamstring strain from the loss at Atlanta, and Kyle Shanahan is pretty optimistic he is fine after the Week 8 bye. He came back and played 34 snaps.

RB6 rest of season for me. Hold him.
#FTTB #DirtyBirds

Lamar Jackson missed a third straight game with the high ankle sprain. Jesse Minter expects him to be in a decent spot for Week 8, and Baltimore will know more Wednesday.

QB2 rest of season for me. Monitor Baltimore's Wednesday practice report.
#RavensFlock

Aaron Jones Sr. is day to day with the knee, per Kevin O'Connell, and the injury is not considered significant.

Jordan Mason out-snapped him 38 to 15 before he left.

Jones is RB27 rest of season for me. Monitor Minnesota's Wednesday practice report.
#Skol

Cam Skattebo avoided a hamstring strain after his 124-yard day at Houston, and the Giants are off in Week 8.

RB23 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a setback in practice before Week 9 changes that.
#NYGiants #HTownMade

Rashid Shaheed left the win over Kansas City with a knee injury, and Mike Macdonald said the early test results are positive. He caught 5 for 66 on 8 targets in Week 6.

WR60 rest of season for me. Monitor Seattle's Wednesday practice report.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

Jadarian Price has his IR practice window opening this week, per Mike Macdonald. He has been out with the chest injury since Oct. 3.

RB37 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#Seahawks

Bryce Young was pulled for Kenny Pickett down 43-6 to Tampa Bay, then showed up as a full participant with the knee on Monday's estimated report.

QB12 rest of season for me. Monitor Dave Canales' starter word before Thursday at Green Bay.
#KeepPounding #GoBucs #GoPackGo

Jalen Coker was limited with the shoulder on Carolina's Monday estimated report, three days before the game at Green Bay.

WR33 rest of season for me. Monitor Carolina's Wednesday injury report.
#KeepPounding #GoPackGo

Matthew Golden sat out Monday's walkthrough with shoulder and foot injuries, a day after 12 targets and 165 air yards at Detroit.

WR25 rest of season for me. Monitor Green Bay's Tuesday practice report before Thursday vs CAR.
#GoPackGo #OnePride #KeepPounding

Klint Kubiak said Kirk Cousins stays the starter for Week 8 against the Jets after a fourth straight loss.

Fernando Mendoza is expected to play at some point. QB33 rest of season for me. Monitor Kubiak's starter call after Week 8.
#RaiderNation #JetUp

Sean McVay did not know Monday whether the Rams open Terrance Ferguson's IR practice window this week.

TE22 rest of season for me. Monitor the window before you spend a bench spot on him.
#RamsHouse

Monday night, Dallas at Philadelphia.

Saquon Barkley is active after two missed games with the hamstring. RB12 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share tonight.

Dameon Pierce played 61 of 64 snaps in Week 6. Hold him as the handcuff.
#FlyEaglesFly #DallasCowboys

Every Monday note is on the Pass, and the Week 8 waiver calls land Tuesday morning.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy so the waiver run hits your feed, and repost this for your league.
